title: Restore and harden local runtime: database restart policy, availability lane activation, branch protection, global guidance
objective: The database comes back by itself after Docker or Windows restarts, the running worker runs the merged availability lane, week 11 NFL games are linked, main requires CI, and both agents load the shared global guidance
next_action: After late games are final, systemctl --user restart arbit-worker; verify started lanes include availability, nfl_api_game week 11 links, and a captured availability event; then document and finish

review.summary: Observed 2026-11-22: arbit-dev-postgres-1 exited (code 0) 2026-11-10T18:06:08Z with restart policy 'no' and stayed down until docker start at 22:44:49Z; the worker logged DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE throughout (first at 2026-11-10 18:06:09Z). The running worker (started 15:25:34 MST) predates local main's fast-forward to the M3 merge (15:26:36 MST), so it lacks the availability lane; daemon.LANES now includes it by default and the unit passes no --lanes. NFL discovery ran 22:44:52Z, 6 s before ESPN created week 11 nfl_game rows (22:44:58Z), so all 13 week 11 nfl_api_game rows have event_id NULL and NFL details are not read until the next discovery 6 h later. GitHub main has no branch protection or rulesets. ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md is absent; ~/.codex/AGENTS.md is 0 bytes.

plan.summary: Owner authorized fixing all identified current-state issues (2026-11-22 chat). Steps: (1) docker update --restart unless-stopped on arbit-dev-postgres-1 (no downtime) and set restart: unless-stopped in infra/compose.yaml so a recreated container keeps it; (2) install the generic global templates with scripts/install_global_instructions.py --apply --replace (backs up the empty Codex file); (3) restart arbit-worker only between the late games' end and Sunday night's kickoff, never mid-game, so it loads main (ec5682a: availability lane) and rediscovers week 11; verify journal 'started' lanes, links and availability capture; (4) protect main on GitHub requiring Foundation validation, Runtime validation and Context governance, enforce_admins off so the owner can still push. Rollback: docker update --restart no; delete installed files / restore .backup; systemctl --user restart arbit-worker after git checkout of the previous commit is not needed (no code change); DELETE branch protection via gh api.
